description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing break with Maria.

Would you like me to write and send (or save a draft of) an email sharing the trip? If so, tell me who to send it to, or pick one of these options:

1) Short, friendly note (quick update)
2) Longer message with highlights (trails, photos, favorite moments)
3) Photo-forwarding email (if you want to attach or forward photos)

Example short message you can send right away:
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body: Hi [Name], I just got back from a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We explored nature trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a really peaceful time. Hope you’re doing well — we’ll share photos soon! Best, [Your name]

Tell me which option you prefer and the recipient (or say “draft” if you want it saved instead of sent), or ask for changes.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
You went on a relaxing weekend trip to the countryside with your sister Maria — you explored nature trails and enjoyed the fresh air. 

Want me to draft or send an email sharing the trip (short update, longer highlights, or photo-forwarding)?
